title: Java Basics
description: Getting a working Java toolchain and writing first programs: installing the JDK, Maven and an IDE, compiling and running a program, primitive types, variables and strings, operators, and choosing and repeating with if/else, switch and loops.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Foundation days F4-F18 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3 to /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2). This module covers F4, F5 (/tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3, /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/4).
Module grouping is a second-mate grouping decision recorded at intake (matrix record source-gap-java-foundations-modules), not syllabus: modules follow calendar day order and hold 4-9 topics.
Every calendar row of these days maps to exactly one topic or project brief with relation exact; there are no splits or shared rows.
Lab-contract pilot: the module lab java-basics/coding-lab (Java 25 and Maven, test command mvn -q -o test, macOS, Linux and Windows) covers all seven topics and is listed in moduleLabs.
